gates: Freeze the nine source / ELF / stdin / oracle identities and signed experimental protocol before the first worker contact.
On the same temporary instance collect only the six calibration arms first; publish calibration.json and its SHA-256 once all 54 executions reconcile.

Do not submit any of the three new held-out programs, including instrumented or native, before verifying the independently sealed predictions SHA-256 and its calibration/corpus hashes. No refit on external native readings.

triplets.order: Within each stage sort IDs and rotate left by 0,1,2 per round. For each input run native-before, ordinary historical three-counter live, native-after in that sequence.

historical_model.purpose: v7 weights bound to ordinary v8 clock for this experiment

boundaries.N: exact median of six full uninstrumented CPU nanosecond readings per external case
boundaries.P: median of three sealed expanded-model integer nanosecond predictions per external case
boundaries.round: use max(1,floor(center_ns*ratio/1000000+0.5)); exact rational until rounded, including half-nanosecond medians
boundaries.order: For each external input in sorted order, visit N-low,N-high,P-low,P-high. For each distinct (case,rounded limit) execute three native repeats; for each N limit additionally execute one ordinary historical live run after the natives. Reuse duplicate rounded limits, retaining all labels.
boundaries.prediction: Offline predicted TLE iff P > limit_ms*1000000, otherwise AC. Record each actual verdict and all mixed/non-success outcomes. No retesting valid discordance.

validation: Each request uses verified native CPU source, nominal and hard limits, expected stdout and full or live-cutoff progress. Record every submitted /execute attempt and all HTTP statuses in the two stages. Record all direct CPU readings and clock counter repeats (including variability), evidence of actual placement, and resource deletion.
